title: After Back and Forward the List keeps its tab, search and filters
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST C368214 Back Forward" has one Approved work order, unit "C368214-U1".
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "Work Orders" tab, "List" shown, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, "Search" empty, browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "Status" and tick "Approved".
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST C368214 Back Forward" in "Search".
  3. Click the row for unit "C368214-U1".
  4. Press the browser Back button.
  5. Press the browser Forward button.
  6. Press the browser Back button.
custom_expected:
Step 1: the "Status" chip shows "Approved".

Step 2: the row for unit "C368214-U1" shows.

Step 3: the work order page for unit "C368214-U1" opens.

Step 4: List comes back on the "Work Orders" tab with "Status" "Approved" and the same rows, as it does in production today.

Step 5: the work order page for unit "C368214-U1" opens again.

Step 6: List shows the same tab, filter and rows as at step 4.

AUTOMATION: READY
